posts.text: ✈️ A NATO reconnaissance aircraft registered in the United States spent several hours in the area of the Kaliningrad Region, despite it being a Saturday, a source in the air traffic control services told TASS. “The Bombardier ARTEMIS II aircraft spent almost five hours in the area of the Russian region, flying in a circle, using the airspace of Poland and Lithuania, as well as sectors over the neutral waters of the Baltic Sea,” the source said. The source said that, as a rule, the aircraft departs from the permanently based airfield in Constanța, Romania, only on weekdays, but recently it has been increasingly spotted on weekends as well.
